custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two vendors, vendor A and vendor B.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close. Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 VENDOR B in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Create a special-order part number for this test that the test location ordered from vendor A first and from vendor B second, but received from vendor B first at a cost of $12.00 and from vendor A last at a cost of $15.00, all within the last 12 months, so vendor A made the most recent delivery.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 LINE S in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. In the line's Parts row click + Add Part, then More options; type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573674-SO in Part Number and pick Add new special order part, type a Description, 1 in Quantity, pick vendor A under Vendor and type a Cost, then click Save Part, and order it. Do the same again with vendor B. Receive vendor B's first at Cost 12.00, then vendor A's at Cost 15.00, each on the Receive screen (Purchase Orders in the left menu, Receive on its row, Vendor Invoice #, Invoice Date, Qty received, then the Receive Parts button).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573674 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, then click Save & Close.
  • Start on work order 1 (Work Orders in the top bar, then open work order 1).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Part Request" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The special-order result shows its source as "Part Library · " followed by vendor A's name, the vendor of the most recent delivery.
  • It does not name vendor B, although vendor B was ordered from last.

Step 3:

  • The result is picked and the Cost field shows 15.00, the cost of vendor A's delivery, not 12.00.

Step 4:

  • The window closes, and work order 1's line shows no new part request.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S12-R14b: “When more than one vendor delivered that number in the last 12 months, the result names the vendor of the most recent delivery and uses that delivery's cost.”
  • S12-R14a: “A special-order lookup result is a part number this location received from a vendor on a special-order line (a received line with no inventory part, and not a core) in the last 12 months.”
  • S12-R14: “A special-order lookup result shows its source as "Part Library · {vendor}".”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, answer 2: “A special-order result is a part number this location received from a vendor on a special-order line in the last 12 months. That's a received line with no inventory part, and not a core (S12-R14a). If more than one vendor delivered it, the vendor of the most recent delivery shows (S12-R14b).”

Partly checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026; not yet seen on that build: ordering and receiving a special-order part (the New Part Request window offered "Add new special order part" once, then "No results").
